deviation.rule: Direct dependencies use exact `=x.y.z` pins with the motivation next to the pin.
deviation.scope: The six workspace dependencies listed here, whose types or traits cross the public Rust API: they keep a compatible `x.y.z` requirement.
deviation.hazard: A consumer build may resolve a newer compatible release than the one qualified; Cargo.lock still fixes the resolution of every build, test, audit and release of this repository.
deviation.reentry: Pin exactly when Plenora ETL vendors the same exact versions or when a resolved release breaks a qualified behaviour; the decision is recorded with the release that changes it.
